First Aid

急救 · 149 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A boy was injured by an infrared stove. Before the ambulance arrived, the unlucky boy suffered several other injuries. First, he swallowed some poisonous liquid from a kettle on the cupboard and began coughing. Then an electric shock burned his wrist, and a pan cut his ankle.

2Fortunately, a nurse gave the boy proper first aid based on his symptoms. She asked someone to call an ambulance, checked his breathing and used a clean dressing to apply pressure to his ankle wound and stop the bleeding. Once the power was off and the area was safe, she cooled the burn under cool running water and covered it loosely with a clean dressing. She also reassured the boy and helped him stay calm until the ambulance crew arrived. Her first aid bought time and played a vital role in saving his life. A ceremony was later held to honour her.

急救

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1一个男孩被红外线炉具弄伤了。救护车还没赶到，不幸的事接二连三地发生在他身上。他先是误喝了橱柜上水壶里的有毒液体，呛得直咳。接着，手腕因触电而烧伤，脚踝又被锅划破了。

2幸好，一名护士根据男孩的情况做了紧急处理。她请人叫来救护车，查看他的呼吸情况，并用干净的敷料按压脚踝的伤口止血。确认电源已切断、现场安全后，她用凉的流动水冲洗烧伤部位，再用干净的敷料松松盖住。她也安慰男孩，让他在救护人员到来前尽量保持镇静。她的急救为救回男孩的生命争取了时间。后来，人们举行仪式表彰了她。
